b0956aff: Why did EA Sports rename “FIFA” to “EA Sports FC” in 2023?
FIFA reportedly asked for over $1 billion to renew the license
FIFA made its own rival game
After 30 years of partnership, EA and FIFA could not agree on the price of the name: FIFA reportedly wanted around a billion dollars. EA kept its league, club and player licenses.
5084cae6: What was the game called before EA Sports FC?
The game was called FIFA followed by the year (FIFA 23, FIFA 22…) from 1993 on. EA Sports FC 24 was the first edition under the new name.
0f9158c0: In what year did the first game in EA Sports' FIFA franchise come out?
FIFA International Soccer came out in 1993 on the Mega Drive/Genesis, the first game of a franchise that would last 30 years. Its isometric view was groundbreaking at the time.
383d55e0: Which game mode was first introduced in FIFA 09?
Ultimate Team (FUT) was introduced as downloadable content for FIFA 09 in 2009. It became the franchise's most played and most profitable mode.
5af53f41: Which story mode featuring Alex Hunter was introduced in FIFA 17?
The Journey, the story mode of FIFA 17 to FIFA 19, followed Alex Hunter's career.
66dc0f9f: Which technology did EA introduce to capture the movements of real players?
HyperMotion Technology was introduced in FIFA 22: EA captures 22 professional players at once to feed a machine-learning model that generates more realistic animations.
91265bca: Which player is on the cover of EA Sports FC 25?
Jude Bellingham, the Real Madrid and England midfielder, is the cover athlete of EA Sports FC 25.
b6bd33d8: Which studio develops EA Sports FC?
EA Sports FC is mainly developed by EA Vancouver (Canada) with EA Romania. EA Vancouver has been the franchise's historic studio since the 1990s.
4ccec6b6: What is the free currency earned by playing FUT called?
FUT Coins are earned by playing matches, selling players or completing challenges. They are used to buy players on the Transfer Market.
43582e3f: What are the premium points bought with real money in FUT called?
FC Points (formerly FIFA Points) are the premium currency bought with real money, used to open packs. They are at the heart of the loot box controversy.
82623c1f: The link between players based on club, league and nationality that boosts their stats
The relationship between manager and team
Chemistry links players by club, league and nationality: better Chemistry boosts their stats on the pitch. In FC 25, each player has individual Chemistry from 0 to 3 points.
40b7b461: What is the maximum Chemistry a player can have in FC 25?
In EA Sports FC 25, each player has individual Chemistry from 0 to 3: the more club, league or nationality links he shares with teammates, the higher it goes.
b648827c: What is a TOTW card in FUT?
A Team of the Week card, for the week's best-performing players
Every week, EA publishes the Team of the Week (TOTW): the best-performing real-life players get an upgraded card, available in packs for a week.
3e8204ab: Top Of The Season: the 11 best players in history
Team of the Season: upgraded cards for each league's best players over the season
Tournament Of The Season: a tournament mode
Top Of The Stars: legendary cards
TOTS (Team of the Season) cards are released at the end of the season for each league's best players (Premier League TOTS, Ligue 1 TOTS…). Their stats are greatly boosted.
8b02e176: What is an Icon in FUT?
The highest-rated player in the game
A retired football legend available as a special card
The rarest card of the season
Icons are cards of retired football legends such as Pelé, Zidane, Ronaldo Nazário, Ronaldinho or Maradona. They come in several versions with increasing ratings.
abce0d9e: What is an Evolution in FUT (introduced in FC 24)?
A system for upgrading a card's stats by completing objectives
Evolutions, introduced in EA Sports FC 24, let you upgrade a card's stats and PlayStyles by completing specific in-game objectives.
978da3af: What is Division Rivals in FUT?
The main competitive mode, where players fight to climb divisions
Division Rivals is FUT's main competitive mode: players earn points to climb from Division 10 to Division 1 and then Elite, with weekly rewards based on rank.
10cdc5c2: What is the Weekend League in FUT?
The high-level weekly competition you qualify for

The Weekend League (FUT Champions) is the high-level weekly competition, reached by earning qualification points in Division Rivals. Matches are played over the weekend with big rewards for top finishes.
847ba7d5: What is a Pack in FUT?
A bundle of random cards bought with FUT Coins or FC Points
A Pack is a bundle of random items: players, managers, consumables. Bought with FUT Coins or FC Points (real money), packs are at the heart of FUT's business model and of the loot box controversy.
b1679796: How does the FUT Transfer Market work?
Players trade cards by auction or at a fixed price
EA runs the market, not the players
The Transfer Market lets players buy and sell cards by auction or at a fixed price, with prices moving with supply and demand. It is the heart of the FUT economy.
f4905d1c: What is a Contract in FUT?
A consumable used up with each match a player plays
The link between manager and team
Contracts are FUT consumables: each match played uses one up on that player, and without contracts he can't play. They come from packs, the market or rewards.
951d0941: Special attributes that unlock unique animations and abilities for a player
How the manager runs the team
PlayStyles were introduced in FC 24, replacing the old Traits. They give players special abilities (Finesse Shot+, Technical+, Block+…) reflecting their real style.
0274b633: A mode where you build a team from randomly offered players for a quick tournament
A mode where you pick your 11 best players
A solo tournament against the AI
FUT Draft lets you pick from randomly offered players to build a team and play a 4-match mini-tournament, with rewards growing with each win.
5913ad06: What is an Objective in FUT?
A goal scored in a match
An in-game challenge that rewards special cards or packs for completing tasks
Objectives are challenges completed by playing: score X goals with a player of a given nation, win Y matches in Rivals, and so on. They often reward unique cards unavailable in packs.
a105e663: Which game mode lets you play 11 v 11 with each human controlling one player?
Pro Clubs lets 11 human players form a full team: each creates their own virtual pro and plays in an online club with real teammates. It is EA Sports FC's most community-driven mode.
f634643e: Which game mode is inspired by street football with small-sided matches?
VOLTA Football is EA Sports FC's street football mode. Inspired by FIFA Street, it offers 3v3, 4v4 or 5v5 matches in urban settings.
496b454f: Which mode lets you run a football club, with transfers, finances and tactics?
Manager Career Mode simulates running a club: transfers, finances, youth development and tactics. You can take over an existing club or create your own.
85dc11ca: Which mode lets you create your own player and follow his career?
Player Career Mode lets you create your own player or play as an existing star: stat progression, performance objectives and transfers depending on results.
f6acfe0c: What is Kick Off mode in EA Sports FC?
Quick, configurable friendly matches, local or online
Kick Off is the quick match mode: friendly matches with any licensed club, locally or online. It includes options like House Rules to vary the rules.
d3554699: What are the rule variants available in Kick Off called?
House Rules are available in Kick Off: variants such as First to Score, Headers & Volleys or Mystery Ball to mix up friendly matches.
63d1193b: What is the highest possible player rating in EA Sports FC?
The maximum rating is 99. Only a few special cards reach it, such as certain Icons or Team of the Year cards.
011d6a33: What is Kylian Mbappé's official position in EA Sports FC 25?
Mbappé is listed as a Striker (ST) in EA Sports FC 25: although he can play on the left wing, EA gives him the ST position because of his main role at Real Madrid in 2024-25.
2c7daee6: Which goalkeeper is regularly among the highest rated in EA Sports FC?
Thibaut Courtois is regularly among the highest-rated goalkeepers: his outstanding 2022 Champions League final and his consistency at Real Madrid earn him high ratings.
694fb08e: Which player has won the most real-life Ballons d'Or, adding to his popularity in EA FC?
Lionel Messi holds the record with 8 Ballons d'Or (the last in 2023), and has long been one of the game's highest-rated and most popular players.
ce426ad4: What is a “Ones to Watch” (OTW) card in FUT?
Cards of players who have just transferred, which upgrade with their performances
The players with the best rating growth

Ones to Watch (OTW) cards are released at the start of the season for players who have just moved to a new club. They upgrade automatically when the player earns a TOTW or other in-form card during the season.
a569918c: What is the squad update that refreshes clubs and transfers in EA FC called?
Roster Updates refresh squads to reflect real transfers: players change clubs and some ratings change. EA releases them regularly throughout the season.
4bc632bd: What do the weak foot stars (1 to 5) mean in EA Sports FC?
Shot speed with the non-dominant foot
Passing accuracy with the non-dominant foot
How well a player can use his weaker foot compared with his stronger one
Shot power with the weak foot only
Weak foot stars show how well a player uses his non-dominant foot: a 5-star player can shoot and pass almost equally well with both feet, while a 1-star player is very limited.
c756a633: What do the skill move stars (1 to 5) represent in EA Sports FC?
The variety and complexity of skill moves a player can perform
The number of different skill moves available
Skill move stars determine which special dribbles a player can perform: a 5-star player can pull off the most complex moves (elastico, rainbow flick), while a 2-star player is limited to basic ones.
1bb81fa9: Which league has carried EA Sports' name since 2023?
Since the 2023-24 season, EA Sports has been the title sponsor of Spain's top league, LALIGA EA SPORTS.
8826b8b7: Is the English Premier League fully licensed in EA Sports FC?
No, only the big six clubs
Yes: every club, stadium, player and kit is official
No, EA doesn't have the Premier League license
The Premier League is one of EA Sports FC's most complete licenses: all 20 clubs, their official stadiums (Anfield, Etihad, Old Trafford…), kits and players.
4173095f: Which Spanish club has the most highly rated players in EA Sports FC 25?
Real Madrid is one of the highest-rated clubs in EA Sports FC 25, with Mbappé, Vinícius Jr., Bellingham and a very deep squad.
692ba6d9: What is the name of EA Sports FC's official esports competition?
EA Sports FC Pro (successor to the FIFAe circuit) is the official global competition, where the world's best players battle through regional qualifiers for the world title.
197e483c: Why do some clubs in EA Sports FC have generic names or kits?
These clubs haven't signed a license deal with EA
When a club has no license agreement with EA, it appears under a modified name with a generic kit and badge.
4cba2b8b: What is AcceleRATE in EA Sports FC?
A system that classifies how a player accelerates (Explosive, Lengthy, Controlled)

AcceleRATE (introduced in FIFA 23) classifies players by acceleration type: Explosive (very fast start), Lengthy (reaches top speed gradually) and Controlled (balanced). It has a big impact on which players are meta in FUT.
2e7d17c3: Which stat matters most for fast wingers in EA Sports FC?
Pace, made up of Sprint Speed and Acceleration, is the key attribute for fast wingers. A player with 90+ pace can outrun most defenders, making it the most sought-after stat in the FUT meta.
16bb1f22: What is a finesse shot in EA Sports FC?
A powerful shot with the strong foot
A curled shot with the inside of the foot, more accurate but less powerful
A finesse shot is struck with the inside of the foot: more accurate and curled than a normal shot, but less powerful. Players with the Finesse Shot+ PlayStyle are even more effective with it.
bc0d2f90: How do penalties work in EA Sports FC?
The player chooses direction and power with the sticks, with timing for accuracy
A rhythm mini-game decides the shot

Penalties in EA Sports FC are taken with the analog sticks and buttons: aim with the left stick, then set power and time the shot. Good timing improves accuracy, while poor timing can send the ball wide.
63043324: What are the Practice Arenas in EA Sports FC?
A free space to practice skill moves, shooting and defending with no stakes
Practice Arenas let you train freely: skill moves, shots, corners, free kicks and more. They are the ideal place to learn the mechanics without competitive pressure.
5673df7b: What is a through ball in EA Sports FC?
A direct pass to a stationary teammate
A pass played into the space behind the defense for a running teammate
A lofted pass over the defenders
A through ball sends the ball into the space behind the defense for a running attacker, one of the most effective attacking weapons against a high defensive line.
ad38cc33: What is the pressing mechanic in EA Sports FC?
A button to speed up with the ball
A defensive action that sends the nearest defender to harass the ball carrier
An attacking technique to break through the defense
Pressing is a defensive action: the dedicated button sends the nearest defender to harass the ball carrier and force a mistake. It is the basis of active defending in EA Sports FC.
ac3a3e7c: What is the stamina bar in EA Sports FC?
The energy gauge that drains during the match, slowing exhausted players
The stamina bar drains gradually during the match: an exhausted player runs slower and performs worse, which is why tactical substitutions matter, especially late in games.
13b0613f: What is a “meta” player in FUT?
The best player in the game's history
A player whose stats perfectly suit the current gameplay
The most expensive player on the market
A meta player is one whose stats and PlayStyles suit the most effective mechanics of the current version, often fast wingers with Explosive AcceleRATE. The meta changes with game updates.
e65af709: Why do FUT player prices fluctuate so much on the Transfer Market?
Supply and demand between millions of FUT users
The player's rating changes every week
Prices are fixed and never change
FUT prices follow the supply and demand of millions of players: a promo that adds more copies of a player lowers his price, while an update that makes a player meta sends his value soaring.
17403bee: What is a price range in FUT?
The minimum rating to enter the Weekend League
The minimum and maximum price a card can be sold for
The cost of a pack on the market
Price ranges are set by EA: each card has a minimum and maximum price on the Transfer Market. They prevent absurd prices but sometimes limit trading.
b0dcfebb: What is the “coin farming” that EA bans in FUT?
Earning coins by playing lots of matches
Using automated software or unfair methods to generate coins en masse
Coin farming (generating coins en masse through automated or unfair methods) is banned by EA, and accounts involved risk being banned. EA monitors suspicious transactions to keep the market fair.
eb7919b7: Why are FUT packs controversial with regulators in several countries?
They are seen as loot boxes, a form of disguised gambling that may target minors
EA doesn't respect the advertised odds
Packs work like loot boxes: you pay without knowing what you'll get. In Belgium, for example, EA stopped selling FIFA Points for packs, and EA now displays pack probabilities.
0e1c86b1: In which EA Sports FC mode can you manage a youth academy?
Manager Career Mode includes a Youth Academy: scout young talent, develop them, then promote them to the first team or sell them. It is one of Career Mode's most popular features.
105cf587: What is VOLTA Story in VOLTA Football?
VOLTA's story mode, with characters and a plot
VOLTA Story was VOLTA Football's story mode: an adventure with fictional characters competing in street football tournaments around the world, unlocking outfits and gear.
e9002910: What does a player's OVR (Overall) rating represent in EA Sports FC?
His overall rating, calculated from all his stats weighted by position

OVR (Overall) is calculated by weighting all of a player's stats according to his position: a center-back is rated mainly on defending, a winger on pace and dribbling. It is the number shown on the card.
9634ebd5: What does “Quick Sell” mean in FUT?
Selling a card directly to EA for a small fixed amount of coins
Listing a player cheaply on the market
Quick Sell lets you sell a card directly to EA for a small fixed amount of FUT Coins: handy for getting rid of duplicates without waiting for a market sale, but not very profitable.
f5e59bd8: What is the name of the new FC 25 feature for customizing tactics in depth?
FC IQ is EA Sports FC 25's new tactical system: it lets you assign specific roles and focuses to each player, not just formations, for much finer tactical customization.
9bb187dd: What is the Seasons system in Pro Clubs?
A system where clubs climb through divisions with rewards
A story mode with real pro clubs
The Seasons system in Pro Clubs lets clubs move up through divisions: wins push you up, defeats can send you down. Trophies and cosmetic rewards recognize the best seasons.
04f3e786: What is the FUT event celebrating the year's best players called?
TOTY (Team of the Year) is the annual dream team revealed at the start of the calendar year: 11 players with the best performances of the previous year. TOTY cards have exceptional ratings.
8a35774c: What is a loan player in FUT?
A player bought on the market
A temporary card of a player available for a limited number of matches
A player lent to another user
Loan players are temporary cards usable for a set number of matches, often given through Objectives or promotional packs. They let you try a player before buying him.
54629f14: Normal cards with an increased rating
Special cards commemorating a highlight of a player's career
Player Moments are special cards commemorating a specific moment in a player's career: a legendary goal, a title, a historic performance.
2c23b95b: What does “SIF” mean in FUT community jargon?
Second In Form: a player's second TOTW card of the season
SIF (Second In Form) is a player's second TOTW card of the same season, rated even higher than his first IF (In Form). TIF (Third In Form) is the third, and so on.
4a5b8b89: What is the “Road to the Final” event in FUT?
Special cards that upgrade as a club progresses in a real European competition
Cards released after a cup final

Road to the Final (RTTF) cards upgrade automatically according to the real results of the player's club in a competition (Champions League, Europa League): the further the team goes, the better the card.
0e0cf9d1: What are FUT Friendlies in EA Sports FC?
Matches against friends or the AI with no ranking at stake
FUT Friendlies let you play matches with nothing at stake: perfect for testing a new lineup, practicing mechanics or simply playing with friends.
dbad40f0: What is Squad Fitness in FUT?
A consumable that restores the fitness of every player in the squad
Squad Fitness is a consumable that restores the fitness of the whole squad in one go, more convenient than using individual fitness cards on each player.
0858dd9c: On the FUT Transfer Market, what does Buy Now let you do?
Buy immediately at the price set by the seller
Buy Now lets you get a card instantly at the price the seller chose. Auctions can work out cheaper, but you have to wait for the timer to run out.
45653ad8: What is an “In Form” (IF) card in FUT?
A weekly upgraded card based on real performances
In Form cards are the upgraded Team of the Week (TOTW) cards given every week to the best-performing real-life players.
60e30226: Cards only for EA Play subscribers
Cards with boosted stats released during events
Special Items are boosted cards released during seasonal events: Ultimate Scream, FUT Birthday, Road to the Final, Winter Wildcards. Their stats are often well above normal.
911962a4: What is FUT's solo mode against AI-controlled teams called?
Squad Battles is FUT's solo mode: you face AI-controlled teams to earn weekly points and rewards, choosing the difficulty from Beginner to Legendary.
36ef50e7: What do you have to do to complete an SBC in FUT?
Submit a squad that meets specific requirements
An SBC (Squad Building Challenge) asks you to submit players who meet requirements (minimum rating, Chemistry, nationality…) in exchange for packs or cards.
d4d62170: How can players boost the stats of a specific player in FUT?
Chemistry Styles are applied to a player to boost certain stats, such as Hunter for pace and shooting, or Anchor for defending and physical.
096e782d: What happens to a player's standard FUT card when he transfers in real life?
His card stays with his old club until the next roster update
A player's standard card stays with his old club until EA's next Roster Update, when it is changed to reflect his new club, league and nationality in FUT.
5a600906: What is a “pack opening” in the FUT community?
Opening FUT packs hoping to get rare players
Pack opening is FUT's loot box system: each pack contains random player cards depending on the pack's rarity. It is a major source of revenue for EA and a moment of suspense for players.
812632d7: What is the name of the FUT event celebrating the mode's own anniversary?
FUT Birthday is the annual event celebrating the mode's anniversary, with special cards featuring creative stat boosts and exclusive promotions.
